source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The test serves generated success/error pages locally, waits for TabClose on the shared tab container and checks one matching request plus one remaining tab. The wait is not bound to a returned tab object. This exercises local content-tab page outcomes; it does not establish system-browser closure, socket-header CSP, token completion or native focus. The exact accepted test proof is reused with its original timestamp.
title: The OAuth result-page test checks local content-tab closure and request counts
